jobs.title: Director, Digital Strategy
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Our mission is to Drive Business Performance. We use data to create personalized and connected experiences that deliver transformative business outcomes. Our role is to ensure our clients meet their quantifiable business goals every day, consistently, in every market. We are entirely focused on delivering better business results through optimization, creation and analysis across all digital platforms. Our scope ranges from recommending how to use content more effectively to optimizing daily media channel performance and maximizing visibility in eCommerce platforms.

The Director, Digital Strategy is the senior strategic digital lead for the client account. The role defines how digital channels work together across the customer journey to support the client’s brand and business goals, and ensures digital thinking is embedded from the brief onward rather than added once activation begins.This is a client-facing leadership role focused on vision, integration and decision-making. The Director turns audience, cultural, platform, business and measurement signals into a focused digital strategy, clear priorities and practical roadmaps. The role brings choiceful recommendations, constructive challenge and a future-facing point of view.

The Director will work alongside Client Leadership and Planning, while partnering closely with the Digital Manager, channel specialists and Media Effectiveness. The Digital Manager and specialists remain responsible for in-platform strategy, buying, account structure, bidding, pacing, optimization, trafficking and quality assurance. The Director sets the strategic direction and ensures the work adds up to one connected digital proposition.

What Success Looks Like

The client can clearly articulate the digital channel strategy, the role of each channel and how the ecosystem supports business growth.
Digital strategy develops at the same pace as the broader media strategy and shapes investment, audience and measurement decisions from the outset.
The client receives concise, decisive recommendations that clarify what matters now, what comes next and why.
Testing, measurement and learning lead to visible changes in strategy, investment and activation.
First-party data, audience and innovation opportunities progress through practical, phased roadmaps with clear ownership and dependencies.
The account operates as one integrated client leadership, planning, digital activation and measurement team.

Key Accountabilities

Digital channel strategy and integration

Own the account’s digital channel strategy and roadmap, connecting business objectives, audience needs, customer journey, channel roles, investment priorities and measurement
Partner with Client Leadership and Planning from the brief onward so digital strategy is developed as part of the core media response, not as a downstream activation layer.
Define how paid Search, Social, Programmatic, Display, Video and other relevant digital channels work together across the funnel, while channel specialists determine the detailed in-platform approach.
Translate complex inputs into a focused set of priorities, choices and actions the client and team can understand and deliver.

Audience, innovation and growth agenda

Develop audience and segmentation strategies that connect broad media audiences, platform signals, app and loyalty opportunities, and first-party data ambitions.
Identify opportunities to improve brand impact, acquisition, engagement, loyalty and media effectiveness, and convert them into sequenced recommendations with clear expected value.
Bring a forward-looking point of view on changing consumer behaviour, platform evolution, AI-enabled media and emerging digital opportunities, distinguishing useful innovation from novelty.
Create a visible innovation agenda for the client that links new opportunities to real business questions, readiness and measurable outcomes.

Measurement, testing and learnin g

With Media Effectiveness and channel leads, define the learning agenda and ensure each priority has a clear business question, hypothesis, success measure and decision rule.
Connect reach, attention, engagement, conversion, efficiency and incrementality evidence to the business question being answered.
Turn reporting and specialist input into concise recommendations on what to continue, change, stop, scale or test next.
Ensure learning is applied back into audience, channel, investment and creative decisions, creating a continuous strategy-to-learning cycle.

First-party data and connected capabilities

Lead the media strategy and use-case components of the first-party data and audience maturity roadmap, in partnership with Media Effectiveness, CRM, loyalty, app, privacy, data and technology stakeholders.
Break complex ambitions into practical phases with explicit ownership, dependencies, decision points and realistic timelines.
First party data connecting to business strategy

Client leadership and team developmen t

Present the digital strategy and roadmap in senior meetings, annual planning, business reviews and critical transformation workstreams.
Coach the Digital Manager, planners and specialists to connect platform recommendations to the wider strategy and communicate with greater clarity and confidence.
Establish clear ways of working and decision rights across Client Leadership, Planning, Digital Activation, Media Effectiveness and specialist partners.

Qualifications

8+ years of progressive experience in digital media strategy, communications planning, digital transformation or integrated media, ideally across agency and/or client environments.
Post-secondary degree or diploma in Media, Advertising, Marketing, Business, Strategy, Analytics or a related field
Demonstrated experience building full-funnel digital channel strategies that connect business goals, audiences, channel roles, investment and measurement.
Strong understanding of the strategic roles and interdependencies of paid Search, Social, Programmatic, Display and Video. Current platform fluency is required; deep hands-on buying or platform-operations expertise is not the core requirement.
Experience translating audience, platform, analytics, research and business signals into a clear strategic point of view and actionable roadmap.
Practical understanding of first-party data, CRM, app and loyalty use cases, including the organizational and measurement dependencies required to activate them.
Experience shaping learning agendas and working with measurement specialists to turn evidence into decisions.
Exceptional client leadership, storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and make decisive recommendations.
Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.

Additional Information

Vacancy:

/N]

The salary range for this position is $100k-115k. Actual salary within the salary range will be based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, knowledge, and skills. A range of medical, dental, RRSP, paid time off, and/or other benefits also are available to all permanent employees.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Media Strategy
jobs.description:
Position Description

ROLE:
MANAGING DIRECTOR , MEDIA STRATEGY(Financial Institution Experience)

TEAM:
ACCOUNTS, SALT MEDIA

LOCATION
: TORONTO (HYBRID)

Company Overview

Salt is a North American marketing agency that creates connected experiences through creative, digital & media innovation. Our mission is to “Earn The World’s Attention” and Salt is built to find, develop, execute, and amplify the ideas that are worthy of our clients’ audiences. We’ve structured our agency to do what’s right for our clients – to connect different perspectives, to work across mediums, and to focus on delivering meaningful, effective results.

We’re committed to living up to the values in our name. “Salt of The Earth” means we value collaborative, humble, hard-working people here. We’re looking for people who are as smart as they are kind because we believe the right talent and the right culture help us do what’s right for our clients.

Role Overview

As a Managing Director, Media, you will lead Salt’s media practice by driving strategic excellence, operational performance, and commercial growth across a portfolio of clients and media investments. You are responsible for shaping media strategy, guiding investment decisions, and ensuring best-in-class planning, buying, measurement, and optimization across all channels.

You oversee multidisciplinary teams, foster senior client relationships, and champion innovation in media technology, audience strategy, and performance marketing. As a senior agency leader, you balance long-term vision with hands-on leadership—stepping in to solve complex business challenges, elevate client outcomes, and create scalable systems that drive growth.

This role is about building a high-performing media practice that delivers measurable business impact. You will be accountable for portfolio performance, media investment stewardship, team development, operational excellence, and expanding Salt’s media capabilities in a rapidly evolving landscape

Core Responsibilities

Media Strategy & Planning Leadership

Lead integrated, full-funnel media strategies across a portfolio of clients, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer journeys, and brand goals.
Establish strategic planning frameworks and media approaches that drive consistency, innovation, and measurable outcomes across teams.
Guide senior media leaders in developing channel strategies, investment allocations, and audience approaches that maximize effectiveness and efficiency.
Partner with Strategy, Creative, Digital, and Account teams to deliver connected marketing solutions that drive business growth.
Represent Salt as a media thought leader through client presentations, industry events, and marketplace engagement.

Media Buying & Investment Management

Oversee media investment across client portfolios, ensuring budgets are optimized to deliver maximum performance and value.
Lead media investment philosophy, governance, and buying practices across all channels and platforms.
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with media partners, publishers, and technology vendors to unlock innovation, preferential pricing, and strategic opportunities.
Negotiate high-value media agreements and partnerships that improve agency leverage and client outcomes.
Ensure media plans and investments remain aligned to business objectives, market conditions, and evolving consumer behaviors.

Measurement, Analytics & Insight Development

Champion data-driven decision-making across the media practice through robust measurement frameworks and reporting standards.
Oversee dashboard strategy, data integration, and performance reporting processes that provide actionable insights to clients and teams.
Guide teams in translating media performance data into strategic recommendations that improve future planning and business results.
Ensure consistent measurement methodologies are applied across client portfolios to support optimization, accountability, and learning.
Promote a culture of testing, learning, and continuous improvement through data and analytics.

Media Technology & Innovation

Lead the adoption and evolution of media tools, platforms, and technologies that improve operational efficiency and campaign effectiveness.
Oversee vendor relationships and platform partnerships to ensure optimal utilization, innovation, and return on investment.
Identify emerging technologies, automation opportunities, and industry trends that can strengthen Salt’s media capabilities.
Collaborate with leadership to establish long-term technology roadmaps that support agency growth and competitive advantage.
Drive innovation initiatives that improve workflow efficiency, scalability, and campaign performance.

Performance Optimization & Audience Strategy

Champion advanced optimization frameworks, automation solutions, and testing methodologies across client portfolios.
Guide teams in developing audience-first strategies that leverage data, segmentation, and behavioral insights to improve effectiveness.
Establish best practices for audience targeting, channel selection, and performance measurement across all media programs.
Lead innovation in automation, optimization, and performance systems that improve efficiency and business outcomes.
Ensure media strategies evolve continuously through audience insights, testing results, and market intelligence.

Financial Leadership

Own portfolio-level financial performance, including media investment oversight, forecasting, profitability, and growth targets.
Monitor media revenue, margins, and operational efficiency while identifying opportunities to improve business performance.
Partner with Finance and agency leadership on forecasting, investment planning, resource allocation, and growth initiatives.
Ensure disciplined financial management across media programs, including budget reconciliation, reporting accuracy, and investment stewardship.
Provide mentorship and guidance to media leaders on commercial acumen, financial accountability, and business management.

Client Growth & Industry Leadership

Build and deepen executive-level client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor on media, marketing, and business growth strategies.
Maintain a deep understanding of client industries, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities.
Drive organic growth through innovative media solutions, integrated marketing programs, and expanded service offerings.
Lead media participation in pitches, RFPs, and new business opportunities.
Represent Salt at senior client, industry, and partner forums, reinforcing the agency’s leadership and expertise in media.

Team Leadership & Culture

Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing media team that embodies Salt’s values and commitment to excellence.
Develop leadership capability across the media department through coaching, succession planning, and career development.
Champion collaboration, accountability, DE&I, innovation, and continuous learning across the team.
Partner with People & Culture to assess talent needs, recruit top performers, and support onboarding and development initiatives.
Create an environment where strategic thinking, creativity, and data-driven decision-making thrive.

Experience & Skills

12+ years of experience in media planning, buying, strategy, performance marketing, or agency leadership, including significant experience leading large client portfolios and media investment programs.
Financial Institution Experience
Proven experience leading integrated media planning and investment strategies across digital, social, programmatic, search, video, broadcast, retail media, and emerging channels.
Demonstrated success defining media investment philosophies, governance frameworks, and scalable planning approaches across multiple clients or business units.
Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience overseeing large-scale media budgets, forecasting, revenue growth, profitability, and operational performance.
Deep expertise in measurement, analytics, reporting frameworks, attribution methodologies, and insight development that drives business outcomes.
Advanced understanding of media technologies, ad platforms, DSPs, ad servers, analytics tools, data ecosystems, and marketing technology solutions.
Track record of driving performance optimization, automation, testing strategies, and innovation initiatives that improve campaign effectiveness and efficiency.
Expert knowledge of audience strategy, segmentation, data application, and targeting methodologies across modern media ecosystems.
Exceptional leadership capabilities with experience building, mentoring, and retaining high-performing teams in fast-paced agency environments.
Skilled relationship builder with the ability to influence executive stakeholders, negotiate strategic partnerships, and serve as a trusted advisor to senior clients.
Outstanding communication and presentation skills with confidence leading C-suite discussions, strategic workshops, and new business presentations.
Passionate about media innovation, technology, data, and marketing effectiveness, with the vision to connect strategy, investment, and execution to deliver measurable business impact.

Perks & Benefits That Set Us Apart

We don’t just talk about balance, growth, and culture, we build for it:

Work-Life Flexibility: Hybrid schedule (2 days per week in office), up to 28 paid days off, winter holiday shutdowns.
Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, and vision plans, plus Salt Bucks to spend on what matters to you—wellness spending, RRSP matching, or extra time off.
Growth-Driven Culture: Learning & Development-focused (Salt Days), top-tier learning access, and formal leadership development.
Celebration-First Mentality: Legendary Company trips, social events, and Salt Swag.
Real Rewards: Referral and new business bonuses and exclusive lifestyle perks
Culture of Belonging: Flexible accommodation policies, active Employee Resource Groups, and a workplace where every voice counts.

What We Stand For

Salt of the Earth: We lead with humility, honesty, and heart—always.
Do What’s Right: No shortcuts. We choose integrity over ease, every time.
Earn Your Salt: We roll up our sleeves, chase results, and celebrate the journey.
Make Things Better: We’re solution-seekers, always pushing for smarter ways forward.
Seek Different Perspectives: Diversity fuels our thinking. Inclusion drives our impact.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $170,000–$200,000.

Individual compensation within the base salary range is determined based on job-related factors such as experience, skills, level of responsibility, internal equity, and business needs. The base salary range listed does not include variable pay or other elements of SALT total rewards program.

Our Pay Philosophy: We offer transparent, fair compensation based on role, experience, and market data. Salaries are reviewed annually.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Finance Director

Cranbrook, British Columbia | Full-time | On-site

$100,000 to $150,000 + benefits

This is not a Finance Director role where you sit above the numbers.

MacKay is looking for a finance leader who can think strategically, work directly with Operations and executive leadership, and still get close enough to the accounting to know whether the numbers are right.

You will lead finance operations for MacKay in heavy civil construction, mining, aggregates and related businesses. The environment is project-driven, equipment-intensive and growing. Cash moves quickly. Capital decisions matter. Project forecasts matter. Bonding capacity matters.

Your job is to make sure the financial side of the business gives the company the information, discipline and capacity it needs to make good decisions and execute.

The Work

MacKay delivers complex civil, mining and infrastructure work across Western Canada, with operations developing in the United States.

That creates a finance environment very different from a conventional corporate accounting role.

You will be dealing with project forecasts, WIP, equipment economics, capital planning, banking, surety, cash flow, multiple entities and operational decisions that can move millions of dollars.

You will work closely with the COO, CEO, General Manager, Operations, Estimating and Equipment teams. You will lead the Corporate Controller and help build the finance team, systems and controls behind the business.

And when something needs to be figured out, you will be expected to get into the detail.

What You'll Get To Lead

Give leadership a clear view of where the business is going.

Build the budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes that allow leadership to see revenue, margin, overhead, cash requirements, backlog and capital needs before decisions have to be made.

Strengthen project financial performance.

Work directly with project leaders on monthly job-cost reviews, forecast-at-completion, WIP and variance analysis. The goal is not simply to report what happened. It is to identify problems early enough that Operations can do something about them.

Own cash, banking and bonding capacity.

Maintain a forward view of cash requirements, working capital, financing and covenant compliance while developing strong relationships with lenders and sureties. You will be directly involved in the financial packages and decisions that support MacKay's ability to pursue and execute larger projects.

Bring discipline to major capital decisions.

MacKay operates an equipment-intensive business. You will work with Operations and Equipment to evaluate fleet investments, utilization, lifecycle cost, financing alternatives and return on capital before significant purchases are made.

Build financial reporting people can actually use.

Turn accounting information into clear P&L, margin, cash, project and KPI reporting that helps the executive team understand what is changing, why it is changing and what requires attention.

Strengthen The Finance Function As The Company Grows.

Develop the Controller and broader finance team, improve systems and processes, strengthen internal controls and build enough depth that the department does not depend on one person knowing everything.

This Is a Hands-On Finance Director Role

You will set financial strategy, work with lenders and sureties, advise the executive team and contribute to major business decisions.

But you also need to understand the accounting underneath those decisions.

There will be times when you need to review an accrual, trace an intercompany balance, understand a journal entry, work through a loan payment or help resolve a payroll or receivables issue.

You do not need to do everything yourself.

You do need to understand it well enough to know when it is right, when it is wrong and what needs to happen next.

You'll Probably Fit Here If

You have spent enough time inside project-based businesses to understand that construction finance cannot be managed entirely from financial statements.

You understand job costing, WIP, percentage-of-completion accounting, cash flow and the relationship between project execution and financial performance.

You are comfortable moving between executive-level conversations and detailed accounting questions.

You can sit with a Project Manager and challenge a forecast, work with an Equipment Manager on a capital purchase, talk bonding capacity with a surety, then explain the financial implications clearly to the executive team.

You also know how to build a finance team without creating unnecessary bureaucracy around the people trying to run the work.

Your Experience Includes

A CPA designation.
10+ years of progressive finance experience, including at least 5 years in senior financial leadership.
Experience in construction, infrastructure, mining or another project-based industry.
Strong project accounting, cash flow, financing and commercial-risk knowledge.
Experience leading finance teams and working directly with banks, lenders, sureties or insurers.

Even Better If You Bring

Experience with multi-entity organizations, cross-border Canadian/U.S. operations, equipment-intensive businesses or aggregates would translate well here.

Experience with construction ERP, job-costing, budgeting and project-control systems would also be useful.

What You Can Expect From MacKay

You will have direct access to the people making operational and business decisions.

You will be expected to challenge assumptions, bring problems forward early and contribute your perspective rather than simply report results after the fact.

This is an established business with real projects, significant equipment, multiple operating entities and an experienced leadership team. At the same time, there is meaningful work still to be done in strengthening systems, reporting, accountability and the financial infrastructure required for the company's next stage.

As the business grows, so will this role. The scope, responsibilities and influence of the finance function will expand alongside the company, creating real opportunity for the right person to grow with it.

The role is based on-site in Cranbrook, British Columbia
.

The normal schedule is Monday to Friday, with additional time required around month-end, year-end, budgeting and major banking or bonding deadlines. Occasional travel to projects and meetings with financial partners will be required.

About MacKay

MacKay Contracting is a heavy civil, mining and aggregates contractor based in the Kootenays.

Since 1986, our teams have delivered challenging infrastructure, earthworks, mining and environmental projects across Western Canada. Today, MacKay continues to build its capabilities and operating footprint while staying focused on the fundamentals that built the company: practical problem-solving, accountable execution and strong people.

Our Values Are Simple

Be Safe Always

Unified as a TEAM

Integrity & Accountability

Lead with Innovation & Excellence

Drive Positive Impact

Interested?

If you are a finance leader who wants to be close to the business, influence real operating decisions and help build the financial platform behind a growing contractor, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Global Treasury and Finance Audit, AVP
jobs.description:
Corporate Audit is looking for an experienced Assistant Vice President (AVP) to lead and execute complex audits and validation work across Global Treasury. The role will primarily cover liquidity risk, interest rate risk in the banking book, investment portfolio, governance, and related regulatory reporting.

The successful candidate will combine strong audit execution and leadership skills with practical knowledge of Treasury risk management. The individual will lead assigned audit teams through planning, testing, issue development, and reporting. They will also review work for quality and evidentiary support and communicate conclusions to senior management.

The role is for an experienced auditor who must be able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, communicate clearly, and already possess strong auditing capabilities.

Why this role is important to us

The audit team plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, the firm, relies on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability; regulators rely upon us to provide assurance that the bank operates in a manner that is compliant with key banking regulations to properly manage risks to the company and the global financial systems.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Global Treasury Audit, AVP you will

Lead complex audits across Global Treasury, from planning, through testing, issue development, and final reporting.
Direct audit teams assigned to individual engagements, establish clear expectations, monitor delivery, review workpapers, and coach team members throughout the engagement.
Plan and perform controls testing, including walkthroughs, sample selection, inspection of evidence, reperformance and evaluation of operating effectiveness.
Evaluate Treasury processes against applicable regulatory requirements, supervisory guidance, internal policies, and established risk limits.
Apply professional skepticism to assess the quality, completeness and reliability of evidence, and challenge unsupported or inconsistent explanations.
Use data analytics to support testing, identify anomalies and enable continuous monitoring where appropriate.
Communicate testing status, emerging concerns, scope changes and delivery risks promptly to audit management, together with fact-based analysis and proposed solutions.
Build constructive relationships across the lines of defense while maintaining audit independence and objectivity.
Maintain current knowledge of Global Treasury risks, regulatory expectations and industry practices, particularly in liquidity risk, asset-liability management and interest rate risk.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

Practical knowledge of Treasury risk management, with experience in liquidity risk, interest rate risk in the banking book, asset and liability management, or a related discipline.
Strong analytical and professional judgment, including the ability to identify the risks that matter and develop well-supported conclusions.
Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, meet commitments and escalate obstacles early in a fast-paced environment.
Clear, factual and concise written and verbal communication, including communication with senior management and regulators.
Ability to research, interpret and apply regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations relevant to Treasury and liquidity requirements and supervisory guidance.
Collaborative approach and ability to provide clear direction and review feedback to audit team members.

Education And Required Qualifications

The following are required:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Risk Management or a related field.
At least 5 years of relevant experience in internal audit, Global Treasury, public accounting, or another first- or second-line risk management role.
Experience leading significant workstreams and audit engagements.
Advanced degree or certification, Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation or its equivalent preferred.

Salary Range

$80,000 - $140,000 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

jobs.title: Senior Media Director, Media Strategy
jobs.description:
ROLE: SENIOR MEDIA DIRECTOR (Financial Institution Experience)

TEAM: MEDIA

LOCATION: TORONTO (HYBRID 2X/WEEK)

Company Overview

At Salt Media
, we're on a mission to earn the world's attention. As the media division of Salt XC, we're building a different kind of agency where media, commerce, creative, data and technology work as a single connected team. Our people combine strategic thinking with AI-powered tools, automation and advanced analytics to help some of North America's most recognized brands solve complex business challenges and drive measurable growth. We move quickly, challenge convention, and believe the best ideas come from curious people who are empowered to experiment. If you're looking to do career-defining work alongside smart, ambitious teammates in an environment that's shaping the future of media, we'd love to meet you.

Role Overview

As a Senior Media Director,
you’ll set the strategic direction for how media investment is planned, bought, and optimized across CPG clients in North America. Operating at the intersection of media strategy and team leadership, you’ll ensure every plan is grounded in strong channel logic, sound investment principles, and a clear line to business outcomes.

You’ll own cross-channel strategy and plan alignment across your portfolio, setting the optimization roadmap and reporting rhythm that keeps campaigns performing against KPIs. You’ll lead a team of media managers and directors — training them on tools and platforms, mentoring their growth, and ensuring the team’s segmentation and audience strategies stay sharp as channels evolve.

You bring a senior media point of view that Account leads and clients rely on, and a team looks up to. You move fluidly between investment strategy and hands-on problem-solving, and you know how to translate performance data into a clear learning agenda for the whole team.

Core Responsibilities

Media Planning & Buying

Lead plan development and investment approach across your portfolio, ensuring every plan is grounded in strong strategic rationale.
Set standards for I/O accuracy, spec compliance, and buy execution across the team.
Own the relationship and day-to-day investment approach with key media platforms and partners, escalating and resolving issues as they arise.
Partner with Account leadership to align media investment with broader account strategy and business objectives.

Integrated Media Strategy

Own cross-channel strategy and plan alignment for your portfolio, ensuring full-funnel thinking connects to brand and business objectives.
Translate client briefs into integrated, cross-channel investment approaches that scale across accounts.
Guide Account and Creative partners on how channel strategy supports the broader campaign narrative.

Measurement, Analytics & Reporting

Lead post-campaign reporting and the learning agenda across your portfolio, ensuring insights translate into sharper future plans.
Build stakeholder trust in the measurement approach, aligning on what success looks like (e.g., brand-building vs. performance KPIs) before campaigns launch.
Guide the team on complex channel plans and measurement matrices, including test-and-learn frameworks.

Media Tools & Platform Fluency

Train and support the team on platform and tool use, ensuring consistent, fluent execution across the portfolio.
Maintain platform reliability and troubleshoot tool-related issues that affect delivery.
Stay current on new platform capabilities and flag opportunities to apply them across accounts.

Performance Optimization & Testing

Set the optimization roadmap for your portfolio and drive its implementation across the team.
Ensure consistent delivery against KPIs, stepping in to course-correct underperforming campaigns.
Champion a test-and-learn mindset, ensuring findings are documented and applied across future plans.

Channel & Audience Expertise

Build segmentation strategies and platform-specific audience logic that sharpen targeting across your portfolio.
Guide the team on applying audience insights and platform data to refine channel-specific approaches.
Stay ahead of shifts in channel and audience behavior, bringing new thinking to the team and to clients.

Leadership, Management & Administration

Manage and develop direct reports across the media team; own performance conversations, goal-setting, and career development planning.
Build team capability and bench strength through deliberate coaching, structured feedback, and stretch assignments.
Model the leadership behaviors and professional standards that define Salt Media’s team culture.
Contribute to team-wide planning processes, hiring decisions, and operational improvements in partnership with departmental leadership.
Champion a culture of accountability, clarity, and continuous improvement within your media team.

Experience & Skills

8–12 years of experience in media planning, buying, or investment strategy, including 5+ years in a senior media leadership role within a media or integrated agency.
Financial Institution Experience
Proven track record leading cross-channel media strategy and investment across a portfolio of clients or campaigns.
Demonstrated people management experience, including direct report oversight, performance management, and career development.
Deep fluency across media platforms, tools, and measurement systems, with the ability to train and elevate a team’s capability.
Strong analytical acumen, with experience translating performance data into a clear learning agenda and optimization roadmap.
Excellent communicator and confident senior presenter; able to align Account, Creative, and client stakeholders around a media point of view.
Strategically minded, with the ability to connect media investment to measurable business outcomes.
Highly organized, decisive, and calm under pressure; able to lead a team through ambiguity while maintaining clarity of direction.

Perks & Benefits That Set Us Apart

We don’t just talk about balance, growth, and culture, we build for it:

Work-Life Flexibility: Hybrid setup, up to 28 paid days off and winter holiday shutdowns.
Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, and vision plans, plus Salt Bucks to spend on what matters to you - wellness, RRSPs, or extra time off.
Growth-Driven Culture: Dedicated Salt Days, learning access, and formal leadership development.
Celebration-First Mentality: Legendary team trips, seasonal socials, and Salt Swag that reps your squad.
Real Rewards: Referral and new business bonuses, phone reimbursement to support your everyday work, exclusive lifestyle perks, and personalized wellness options.
Culture of Belonging: DEI programs, active ERGs, and a workplace where every voice counts.

What We Stand For

Salt of the Earth: We lead with humility, honesty, and heart — always.
Do What’s Right: No shortcuts. We choose integrity over ease, every time.

jobs.description:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About The Job

OpenTable is seeking a strategic and operationally-minded Director of FP&A to lead financial planning, forecasting, and analysis for our core operational investments. Located in our Toronto office, this role will have primary ownership over the company’s Operating Expenses (OpEx), Capital Expenditures (CapEx), and Commissions modeling and structures. Reporting to the VP, FP&A, you will act as a key business partner to departmental heads, ensuring disciplined resource allocation, optimization of capital investments, and the implementation of commission plans that align with corporate growth objectives. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Responsibilities

OpEx Management & Forecasting: Lead the annual budgeting and monthly forecasting processes for global operating expenses. Partner with department heads ( tech, sales, marketing, G&A) to track spend, analyze variances, and identify cost-efficiency opportunities.
CapEx Planning & Governance: Oversee the evaluation, tracking, and prioritization of capital expenditures. Develop robust ROI models for major technology, infrastructure, and facilities investments to guide executive decision-making.
Commissions Oversight: Own the financial oversight of the commission program. Partner with Sales Operations to ensure commission plans are accurate and effective.
Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted financial advisor to operational leadership, translating complex financial data into actionable insights that drive strategic initiatives.
Management Reporting: Deliver clear monthly and quarterly financial review packages focusing on spend efficiency, capital deployment, and incentive plan effectiveness for senior leadership.
Process & Systems Improvement: Continuously scale and automate FP&A processes, particularly around expense tracking and commission calculations, to support organizational growth.

Qualifications

Experience: 7–10 years of progressive experience in corporate finance, FP&A, or strategic finance, with a strong emphasis on expense management, capital budgeting, and sales compensation finance.
Leadership: Demonstrated experience managing professional finance team members and leading cross-functional projects.
Analytical Skills: Advanced financial modeling skills (Excel/Google Sheets) and experience handling large datasets. Proficiency with financial planning tools, ERP software, and commission management platforms (e.g., CaptivateIQ).
Communication: Strong ability to influence and build partnerships with non-finance executives by presenting financial concepts clearly and concisely.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Benefits and Perks

Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
Focus on mental health and well-being:
Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
Company-paid subscription to Headspace
Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

Paid parental leave
Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
Paid volunteer time
Focus on your career growth:
Development Dollars
Leadership development
Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

Travel Discounts
Employee Resource Groups
20 days of paid time off
Private health and dental insurance
Life and Disability insurance

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus and equity grant.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. Represent Salt as a media thought leader through client presentations, industry events, and marketplace engagement.

Ensure media plans and investments remain aligned to business objectives, market conditions, and evolving consumer behaviors.

Oversee dashboard strategy, data integration, and performance reporting processes that provide actionable insights to clients and teams.
Guide teams in translating media performance data into strategic recommendations that improve future planning and business results.
Ensure consistent measurement methodologies are applied across client portfolios to support optimization, accountability, and learning.
Promote a culture of testing, learning, and continuous improvement through data and analytics.

Media Technology & Innovation

Lead the adoption and evolution of media tools, platforms, and technologies that improve operational efficiency and campaign effectiveness.
Oversee vendor relationships and platform partnerships to ensure optimal utilization, innovation, and return on investment.
Identify emerging technologies, automation opportunities, and industry trends that can strengthen Salt’s media capabilities.
Collaborate with leadership to establish long-term technology roadmaps that support agency growth and competitive advantage.
Drive innovation initiatives that improve workflow efficiency, scalability, and campaign performance.

Performance Optimization & Audience Strategy

Champion advanced optimization frameworks, automation solutions, and testing methodologies across client portfolios.
Guide teams in developing audience-first strategies that leverage data, segmentation, and behavioral insights to improve effectiveness.
Establish best practices for audience targeting, channel selection, and performance measurement across all media programs.
Lead innovation in automation, optimization, and performance systems that improve efficiency and business outcomes.
Ensure media strategies evolve continuously through audience insights, testing results, and market intelligence.

Financial Leadership

Own portfolio-level financial performance, including media investment oversight, forecasting, profitability, and growth targets.
Monitor media revenue, margins, and operational efficiency while identifying opportunities to improve business performance.
Partner with Finance and agency leadership on forecasting, investment planning, resource allocation, and growth initiatives.
Ensure disciplined financial management across media programs, including budget reconciliation, reporting accuracy, and investment stewardship.
Provide mentorship and guidance to media leaders on commercial acumen, financial accountability, and business management.

Client Growth & Industry Leadership

Build and deepen executive-level client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor on media, marketing, and business growth strategies.
Maintain a deep understanding of client industries, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities.
Drive organic growth through innovative media solutions, integrated marketing programs, and expanded service offerings.
Lead media participation in pitches, RFPs, and new business opportunities.
Represent Salt at senior client, industry, and partner forums, reinforcing the agency’s leadership and expertise in media.

Team Leadership & Culture

Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing media team that embodies Salt’s values and commitment to excellence.
Develop leadership capability across the media department through coaching, succession planning, and career development.
Champion collaboration, accountability, DE&I, innovation, and continuous learning across the team.
Partner with People & Culture to assess talent needs, recruit top performers, and support onboarding and development initiatives.
Create an environment where strategic thinking, creativity, and data-driven decision-making thrive.

Experience & Skills

12+ years of experience in media planning, buying, strategy, performance marketing, or agency leadership, including significant experience leading large client portfolios and media investment programs.
Financial Institution Experience
Proven experience leading integrated media planning and investment strategies across digital, social, programmatic, search, video, broadcast, retail media, and emerging channels.
Demonstrated success defining media investment philosophies, governance frameworks, and scalable planning approaches across multiple clients or business units.
Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience overseeing large-scale media budgets, forecasting, revenue growth, profitability, and operational performance.
Deep expertise in measurement, analytics, reporting frameworks, attribution methodologies, and insight development that drives business outcomes.
Advanced understanding of media technologies, ad platforms, DSPs, ad servers, analytics tools, data ecosystems, and marketing technology solutions.
Track record of driving performance optimization, automation, testing strategies, and innovation initiatives that improve campaign effectiveness and efficiency.
Expert knowledge of audience strategy, segmentation, data application, and targeting methodologies across modern media ecosystems.
Exceptional leadership capabilities with experience building, mentoring, and retaining high-performing teams in fast-paced agency environments.
Skilled relationship builder with the ability to influence executive stakeholders, negotiate strategic partnerships, and serve as a trusted advisor to senior clients.
Outstanding communication and presentation skills with confidence leading C-suite discussions, strategic workshops, and new business presentations.
Passionate about media innovation, technology, data, and marketing effectiveness, with the vision to connect strategy, investment, and execution to deliver measurable business impact.

Perks & Benefits That Set Us Apart

We don’t just talk about balance, growth, and culture, we build for it:

Work-Life Flexibility: Hybrid schedule (2 days per week in office), up to 28 paid days off, winter holiday shutdowns.

Real Rewards: Referral and new business bonuses and exclusive lifestyle perks
Culture of Belonging: Flexible accommodation policies, active Employee Resource Groups, and a workplace where every voice counts.

Salt of the Earth: We lead with humility, honesty, and heart—always.
Do What’s Right: No shortcuts. We choose integrity over ease, every time.
Earn Your Salt: We roll up our sleeves, chase results, and celebrate the journey.
Make Things Better: We’re solution-seekers, always pushing for smarter ways forward.
